scope: Engineering comparison against directly constructed native Gaussian tensors; no scientific objects or holdout photos

colmap.xy_pixel_centers: COLMAP upper-left pixel centre is (0.5,0.5); subtract 0.5 from cx,cy for integer-centre bundle K

gaussians.graphdeco_color: display-sRGB coefficients, +0.5 SH bias and nonnegative colour, black background, composite then clamp [0,1]
gaussians.project_color: sigmoid linear RGB, black compositing then IEC sRGB display transfer
gaussians.asset_units: centimetres in original fixture; distances multiply by .01 and log-scales add log(.01); orientations wxyz unit quaternion

contains: nonzero coefficients in all RGB channels for SH3 orders 1 to 3

comparisons.rasterizer: gsplat 1.5.3 CUDA classic; packed=false; eps2d=.3; near=.01 m, far=100 m; RGB+ED; black background
comparisons.native: independently authored metric camera/native parameters, independent per-view SH evaluation; same physical rasterizer
comparisons.criteria: every view and input branch passes; compare all float32 RGB and alpha pixels and ED wherever either image has alpha positive, exactly match support masks

probe.optical_axis_probe: central and off-axis overlap compare camera-Z vs accumulated D divided by opacity; expected camera-Z only

comparisons.calibration_without_truth: default original threshold; additional empirical operation only for explicitly pinned matching fixed layout and method; no actual per-frame error claimed

reject: unknown or incomplete SH field set
missing referenced source image or dimension mismatch
absent CUDA for rendering or unsupported gsplat version
reporting: Per-view original and imported outputs, extrema/sums and denominators, independent RGB/ED/alpha and representation timings; control of real heat, costs and failures separate CPU parsing, CUDA rendering and CPU scoring. Failed rows persist; no substitution.
